description:
Use this when you need a deterministic US federal employee/office date offset in 2026-2027. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need state/local/private-employer, exchange or alternate-work-schedule semantics.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts dates using the pinned OPM federal schedule and US weekend baseline.
Example user requests: Add five US federal working days after 2027-06-17.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2027-06-17","working_days":1}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, federal_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_observed, holiday_actual_dates, weekend_days, rest_day_policy, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, source_quality, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement remaining only when US federal status.is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/us-federal-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/us-federal-add-working-days.md

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date is excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_us_federal_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Federal employees and federal offices only.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, regular weekend or OPM federal holiday.

holiday_actual_dates.description: Underlying statutory holiday dates for observed events.

holiday_names.description: OPM federal holiday names applying on the date.

holiday_observed.description: True when the date is the OPM in-lieu/observed date for a holiday whose actual date is a weekend.

rest_day_policy.description: OPM alternative work schedules need separate in-lieu resolution.

source_quality.description: Official OPM schedule and federal-law references.

sources.description: Official OPM, federal guidance and legislation sources.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add US Federal Working Days
